title: [Salty's Services, Warehouse]
description: The dissonance between storefronts on either side of the broad path is pronounced.  Alongside well-maintained buildings with pristine, shining materials lined with colorful banners and signage, dumpy-looking driftwood assemblages lean upon their better-maintained neighbors like drunken family members at parties who have had one too many.  Passers-by stop and consider options on their path down the thoroughfare, and the overall warehouse size causes voices to carry into its ceilings with a faint echo.
